description_en: Queries abnormal SQL patterns within a time range
description_zh: 对指定时间范围内，执行指标异常的Pattern进行检测
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-abnormal-pattern-detection --db-cluster-id am-xxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAbnormalPatternDetection

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看集群的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The language. Valid values:

zh (default): simplified Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
语言配置，取值说明：
zh：简体中文（默认语言）。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

DetectionItems.description_en: The queried detection items and detection results
DetectionItems.description_zh: 检测项及检测结果列表

items.description_en: The queried detection item and detection result
items.description_zh: 检测项及检测结果列表

Message.description_en: The description of the detection result
Message.example: Two SQL patterns that have abnormal totalTime metric values are detected. This may cause high CPU usage or slow queries, which affects system stability. Go to the monitoring page and use one-click diagnostics to view details and optimize the queries.

Name.description_en: The name of the detection item

AccessIp.description_en: The IP address of the SQL client that submits the SQL pattern
AccessIp.description_zh: 提交Pattern的相关SQL客户端IP地址

Detail.description_en: The details about the detection report of the SQL pattern

FailedCount.description_en: The number of failed SQL patterns within the time range
FailedCount.description_zh: 查询时间范围内，Pattern的失败次数

QueryCount.description_en: The number of executed SQL patterns within the time range
QueryCount.description_zh: 查询时间范围内，Pattern的执行次数

RelatedMetrics.description_en: The metrics related to the SQL pattern
RelatedMetrics.example:
Maximum query duration: 1.43s
Maximum peak memory: 20.73 MB
Maximum table read data volume: 10.12 MB

SQLPattern.description_en: The SQL statement that represents the SQL pattern

User.description_en: The name of the database account that is used to submit the query

Status.description_en:
The severity level of the detection result. Valid values:

NORMAL
WARNING
CRITICAL
Status.description_zh:
检测结果状态。取值：

NORMAL
WARNING
CRITICAL

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
